{{Quote|Ah, don't listen to an old ''gogi'' like me.|[[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]]|<ref name="FLT">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>}}
'''''Gogi''''' was a title in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. Bestowed upon an elderly [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] often seen as past their fighting prime, but still in possession of valuable experience, a ''gogi'' served as a trainer and overseer of Mandalorian [[Commando/Legends|special forces]]. It was within the ''gogi''{{'s}} authority to determine when and where a warrior under their tutelage traveled, and could recall their warriors if they were needed by the Mandalorian [[Army/Legends|army]]. Mandalorians who trained under a ''gogi'' often remember their mentor and the experience fondly, and many subsequently looked forward to becoming a ''gogi'' themselves.<ref name="TUR" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the veteran Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]] was a ''gogi'' living on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]], where he resided in the enclave of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]].<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of ''gogi'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' sourcebook, written by [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Rodney Thompson]], and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published [[April 20]], [[2010]].<ref name="TUR" /> The title was later mentioned again in the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published [[December 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="FLT" />
